    "Limitations in advanced design features compared to professional software.",
    "Can sometimes feel repetitive if relying heavily on popular templates.",
    "Occasional difficulty with very precise brand guideline adherence without deeper customization options."

  "overall_experience": "As a co-owner in a small business, they likely found Canva to be an incredibly valuable tool for their social media and ad campaign content. While it may lack some advanced features, its core functionality perfectly met their marketing needs, making it a highly recommended solution for similar businesses."
